rationale: The one source change narrows the manual-mode conflict probe to skip issue dirs whose durable start.json names a different config - mirroring the matchesConfig test the nested-legacy branch beside it already applies, and staying conservative for incomplete dirs that carry no start.json - and I verified its new test fails with exit 2 on the pre-revision pin and passes here, that the full declared suite is green (build, lint, typecheck, 353 fast tests, 2 e2e), and that every property that made this implementation the selected one is untouched: mandatory workspace group for manual names, a set-environment -u argv real tmux accepts, config-relative agent roots, and manual guards on all four automated entry points.
